SAR-ACD.archive_sha256_anchor_note: No complete archive SHA was independently obtained before preparation; do not replace this with a single-image SHA.
SAR-ACD.protocol_warning: 200 development images per class means 160 train plus 40 validation, not the literature's 200 training images per class. This is a new local controlled protocol, not reproduction of the author's split. Expanded-image scene/source independence is not established.

SAMPLE.evidence: experiments/rgsp_table_completion_20261012_v1/data_audit/NEXT_BATCH_READINESS.md and c_sample_names.txt, read-only filename inventories 2026-10-12 10:26-10:29 +08:00; not a full content audit.
SAMPLE.representation: decibel only; qpm is excluded, not treated as independent data
SAMPLE.integer_rounding: Per-class largest remainder for 4:1 train:val; RGB groups indivisible. Refuse if exact integer quotas cannot be achieved.
SAMPLE.selection_policy: Training and checkpoint selection use synthetic 14-16 degrees only; all 539 real 17-degree images are sealed final test. Do not use the real domain to select a checkpoint, threshold, normalization, or hyperparameter.
SAMPLE.protocol_warning: This is domain/depression-angle transfer, not serial/instance-disjoint testing. The per-class serial is shared across domains. It differs from the old real-only random split and the earlier fixed-10000-update/no-validation proposal.

SADD.evidence: experiments/rgsp_table_completion_20261012_v1/data_audit/NEXT_BATCH_READINESS.md, d_sadd.txt, d_sadd_archive_layout.txt; read-only count evidence, not full2966 content validation.
SADD.integer_rounding: Within each positive/negative stratum, train=floor(0.8*N), val=floor(0.1*N), test=remainder; exact RGB content groups stay together.
SADD.protocol_warning: A new image-level protocol including all negative images, not the historical positive-only795/44/44 split and not an official or scene-disjoint protocol. Numeric filenames are not scene IDs. SADD is not the seven-class SAR-AIRcraft1.0 dataset.
SADD.label_policy: Keep raw YOLO label bytes and class semantics unchanged; retain empty labels and images. Identical RGB content with different semantic annotations blocks preparation.
